name: setValueInvalidStateThrowsException
expected: Throws IllegalStateException because canRemove is false, indicating setValue cannot be called before next() or after remove()/reset().

name: setValueWithNullValue
input: canRemove = true, nextIndex = 1, parent.value1 = "oldValue", value = null
expected: Returns "oldValue" and updates parent.value1 to null successfully.

name: setValueReplacingNullWithNonNull
input: canRemove = true, nextIndex = 2, parent.value2 = null, value = "newValue"
expected: Returns null and updates parent.value2 to "newValue".

name: setValueMultipleTimesConsecutively
input: canRemove = true, nextIndex = 1, parent.value1 = "v1", value = "v2", then value = "v3"
expected: First call returns "v1" and sets "v2"; second call returns "v2" and sets "v3".

name: setValueDelegateMode
input: canRemove = true, map in delegate mode, entry value = "oldDelegateVal", value = "newDelegateVal"
expected: Delegates the set operation to the underlying map entry and returns "oldDelegateVal".
